cas: # A short hand-picked list: the formula and common English names of the
# substances a person most often types by formula. A flow search reads a
# whole query against these names to find the flows carrying that CAS, so
# "N2O" finds a database's "Dinitrogen monoxide". Two-letter formulas (CO,
# NO, HF) are left out: their letters sit inside many other names.
# scripts/build_chem_synonyms.py can replace this file with a PubChem snapshot.
